_comment_composition: 10% water-based liquid scintillator. Bulk optical properties are inherited from pure water (negligible difference at 10% mass fraction); only the scintillation block is the actual WbLS physics.

scattering.source: SK calibration paper (arXiv:1307.0162) — reused from water; WbLS bulk scattering differs by <1% at 10% mass fraction.

symmetric.description: Rayleigh + symmetric Mie: alpha_sym = P4/lambda^4 * (1 + P5/lambda^2)

asymmetric.description: Forward Mie: alpha_asym = P6 * (1 + P7/lambda^4 * (lambda - P8)^2)

absorption.source: SK calibration paper + Pope & Fry (1997) — reused from water. Knots synced 2026-07 with water.json's corrected omlc.org values.
absorption.description: alpha_abs = P0*P1/lambda^4 + C(lambda); C = power law (<464nm) or Pope&Fry (>=464nm)

light_yield._comment: Chou parametrization (Birks + bimolecular). 10% WbLS: S from Caravaca 2020 (arXiv:2006.00173) linear fit S(c=10) = 127.9*10 + 108.3 = 1387.3 ph/MeV. kB and C from Callaghan 2023 (arXiv:2210.03876) Table 6 Chou row.

timing._comment: Single rise+fall hypoexponential — sampled directly via T_rise + T_fall, T_X ~ Exp(tau_X). 10% WbLS fast component from Caravaca 2020 Table 2 (tau_r=0.13, tau_1=2.70). The slow tau_2=27.05 ns component (R_1=0.06) is dropped — it carries 6% of the integrated emission and adds noise to the simulator without a calibration handle to exploit it.

spectrum._comment: Moyal (approximate Landau) fit to WbLS emission spectrum from arXiv:2003.10491. The surrogate samples directly from this distribution truncated to [lambda_min, lambda_max] via an inverse-CDF lookup; moyal_amp is dormant (preserved on DetectorParams for future reactivation).

photon_split._comment: Static ratio used only when both Cherenkov and Scintillation are enabled. 0.5 = equal-cost split of the user's n_photons budget.
